title: A large surface
hook: A body part can move heat without moving the animal.

knows: Animals have body structures and life histories.
doesNotKnow: Describe heat exchange at an elephant ear.

misconception: A familiar animal feature always has the first explanation that comes to mind.
objective: Describe heat exchange at an elephant ear.

claims.text: How can an elephant’s ears help the animal lose heat? The ear schematic shows vessels carrying warm blood near a broad surface. When the surrounding air is cooler, heat can flow outward. Ear movement and environmental conditions affect the rate, so the diagram is a mechanism rather than a measured cooling amount.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: Smithsonian National Zoo, elephant anatomy, https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/elephant

claims.text: The elephant head, ear vessels, heat arrows and labels are schematic, not to scale and not an observation. Ear vessels · schematic.
An elephant moves blood through vessels in its ears. What can happen when the surrounding air is cooler? Blood vessels near the ear surface can exchange heat with cooler surrounding air.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: Smithsonian National Zoo, elephant anatomy, https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/elephant

recall.question: An elephant moves blood through vessels in its ears. What can happen when the surrounding air is cooler?
options: Heat can move from blood to the air
The ear becomes a water reservoir
